- Wrote SQL queries in PostgreSQL to aggregate settlements by merchant and date.
- Packaged the report service as a Docker image for the staging cluster.
- Worked in Git with code review from two senior engineers.

Web Intern, Codeleaf Labs, Remote | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)
- Built admin pages in React for an internal tool.

PROJECTS
- URL Shortener in Go: REST API with PostgreSQL storage and rate limiting.
- Log Tail Worker Pool: Concurrent log parser in Go that processes 1 GB of logs with a worker pool.
- Chat app: WebSocket chat server in Node.js for the Computer Networks course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Operating Systems, DBMS, Computer Networks, Data Structures and Algorithms
- Go: The Complete Developer's Guide (Udemy), 2025

SKILLS
Go, Gin, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, Go testing package, Linux, JavaScript, C++

ACTIVITIES
